description: Shared feature contract for the bot-vs-human session model. The Python trainer (ml/train_bot.py FEATURES, gold.session_features) and the Go stream score-writer (api/internal/scorewriter/features.go BotFeatures, a pure field mapping over the session.end event) must agree on exactly these names; the sidecar refuses a vector missing any of them. The file lives in the Go module because Go embeds it; both test suites assert against it.
